risks.title: Cybersecurity
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to cybersecurity threats due to the online nature of its operations and must maintain the confidentiality of personal and business information, as noted in Item 1A Risk Factors (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Competition
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in a competitive market where other firms offer similar marketplace services, which could affect its business and revenues (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Geopolitical and Armed Conflicts
risks.score_rationale: International geopolitical conflicts, including the war in Ukraine and tensions in the Middle East, can impact financial markets and trade. However, the company notes that its direct revenues associated with Russia, Ukraine, and Israel were not material for fiscal year 2025 (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Commercial and Trade Regulation
risks.score_rationale: The company is subject to changing government and commercial regulations. Customs tariffs and other trade barriers may affect buyers and sellers, as well as the availability of assets for sale on marketplaces (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Macroeconomic and Inflationary Conditions
risks.score_rationale: Macroeconomic fluctuations including inflation, high interest rates, and market volatility can impact the company's business. Inflation has increased energy, shipping, and labor costs, affecting borrowing costs and transaction timelines (default score, to be refined)
